goal: flywheel status and history invoked from a working copy whose local sqlite is empty report the runs, claims, and stop events another instance recorded in the shared postgres database.

graders.name: behavior
graders.run: bash -c 's=$(uv run pytest packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_status_distributed.py -q 2>&1); r=$?; echo "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -qi skipped && exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -q " passed"'

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- status/history verbs; _stop_events_by_subject constructs SqliteClaimStore directly (~line 1383); module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_store_factory.py -- the policy-driven factory these reads must route through
constraints: Every production read of claims and stop events routes through the same policy-driven factory postgres-data-plane-routing shipped; no read path constructs a sqlite claim store directly when the backend is postgres

The new test populates postgres through one store configuration, then reads status/history under a second working copy whose local sqlite is empty, asserting the originating run identifiers and stop-event-derived state appear
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change status/history rendering formats beyond sourcing the data from the configured backend
Do not add cross-backend dual-read or any sqlite-to-postgres migration (spec D-3)
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: The partial fix must fail: output showing postgres runs while stop events still come from local sqlite fails the behavior test
An empty postgres under backend = postgres renders the normal empty status, not an error
